scope: 255 reviewed P0/P1 strings only; not whole-language or runtime certification

formats22_animation_message.source: This %1$s contains %2$s frames. AN Paint edits still images and does not preserve animation.
formats22_animation_message.expected: "ይህ %1$s %2$s ፍሬሞችን ይዟል። AN Paint የማይንቀሳቀሱ ምስሎችን ያርትዓል፤ እንቅስቃሴን አያስቀምጥም።"

formats22_animation_poster.source: This PNG has a separate default image. That image will be imported instead of the animated frames. Saving creates a still image.
formats22_animation_poster.expected: "ይህ PNG የተለየ ነባሪ ምስል አለው። ከሚንቀሳቀሱት ፍሬሞች ይልቅ ያ ምስል ይገባል። ሲቀመጥ የማይንቀሳቀስ ምስል ይፈጠራል።"

formats22_animation_still.source: Only the first frame will be imported. Saving creates a still image.
formats22_animation_still.expected: "የመጀመሪያው ፍሬም ብቻ ይገባል። ሲቀመጥ የማይንቀሳቀስ ምስል ይፈጠራል።"

formats22_animation_unknown.source: This %1$s is too complex to confirm whether it contains multiple frames. AN Paint will open only a still image and will not preserve any animation.
formats22_animation_unknown.expected: "ይህ %1$s ብዙ ፍሬሞችን እንደያዘ ለማረጋገጥ ከመጠን በላይ ውስብስብ ነው። AN Paint የማይንቀሳቀስ ምስል ብቻ ይከፍታል፤ ማንኛውንም እንቅስቃሴ አያስቀምጥም።"

formats22_ascii_description.source: Writes plain text using light and dark characters. View it in a monospaced font. This is a visual rendition; it cannot be reopened as the original image.
formats22_ascii_description.expected: "ፈዛዛና ጥቁር ቁምፊዎችን በመጠቀም ቀላል ጽሑፍ ይጽፋል። እኩል የቁምፊ ስፋት ባለው ቅርጸ ቁምፊ ይመልከቱት። ይህ በጽሑፍ የተወከለ ምስል ነው፤ እንደ ዋናው ምስል እንደገና ሊከፈት አይችልም።"

formats22_derived_exported.source: %1$s exported. Your full drawing still has unsaved changes; save a full image copy before replacing it.
formats22_derived_exported.expected: "%1$s ወደ ውጭ ተልኳል። ሙሉ ስዕልዎ አሁንም ያልተቀመጡ ለውጦች አሉት፤ ከመተካትዎ በፊት የሙሉ ምስሉን ቅጂ ያስቀምጡ።"

formats22_pdf_raster_hint.source: PDF pages are rendered at 144 dpi. Text and vector objects become pixels.
formats22_pdf_raster_hint.expected: "የPDF ገጾች በ144 dpi ወደ ምስል ይቀየራሉ። ጽሑፍና የቬክተር ነገሮች ወደ ፒክሰሎች ይቀየራሉ።"

gallery_credit_could_not_save.source: The image credits could not be saved or restored. Existing saved credits have been kept. Try again.
gallery_credit_could_not_save.expected: "የምስሉን ምንጭ መረጃ ማስቀመጥ ወይም መመለስ አልተቻለም። ቀድሞ የተቀመጠው መረጃ ተጠብቋል። እንደገና ይሞክሩ።"

gallery_credit_too_large.source: These image credits would make the drawing too large to restore. Your previous drawing and credits have been kept.
gallery_credit_too_large.expected: "ይህ የምስል ምንጭ መረጃ ስዕሉን መልሶ ለመክፈት ከሚቻለው መጠን በላይ ያሳድገዋል። የቀድሞው ስዕልዎና መረጃው ተጠብቀዋል።"

legacy_credits_unreadable.source: Some saved credits could not be read. Their stored copies have been kept.
legacy_credits_unreadable.expected: "ከተቀመጠው የምንጭ መረጃ ውስጥ አንዳንዱን ማንበብ አልተቻለም። የተከማቹት ቅጂዎች ተጠብቀዋል።"

save20_destination_error.source: The completed image could not replace its destination.
save20_destination_error.expected: "የተጠናቀቀው ምስል በመዳረሻው ያለውን ፋይል መተካት አልቻለም።"

save20_encoding_budget.source: The image and encoding buffers exceed the export memory budget.
save20_encoding_budget.expected: "ምስሉና የምስል ኢንኮዲንግ ጊዜያዊ ማከማቻዎች ወደ ውጭ ለመላክ ከተመደበው የማህደረ ትውስታ መጠን ይበልጣሉ።"

save20_gif_description.source: Still image, up to 256 colours. Dithering smooths colour gradients. Animated GIFs open as their first frame.
save20_gif_description.expected: "የማይንቀሳቀስ ምስል፣ እስከ 256 ቀለሞች። የቀለም ነጥቦችን ማቀላቀል የቀለም ሽግግሮችን ለስላሳ ያደርጋል። የሚንቀሳቀሱ GIF ምስሎች በመጀመሪያው ፍሬማቸው ይከፈታሉ።"

save20_invalid_name.source: Enter a file name without slashes or control characters.
save20_invalid_name.expected: "ሰያፍ ሰረዞች ወይም የመቆጣጠሪያ ቁምፊዎች የሌሉበትን የፋይል ስም ያስገቡ።"

save20_lossy_quality_description.source: Higher quality preserves more detail and usually makes a larger file.
save20_lossy_quality_description.expected: "ከፍተኛ ጥራት ተጨማሪ ዝርዝር ይጠብቃል፤ ብዙውን ጊዜም የፋይሉን መጠን ያሳድጋል።"

save20_unsupported_image_colour.source: This image uses a colour profile that AN Paint cannot convert yet. Convert it to sRGB PNG in a colour-managed editor before importing.
save20_unsupported_image_colour.expected: "ይህ ምስል AN Paint ገና መቀየር የማይችለውን የቀለም መገለጫ ይጠቀማል። ከማስገባትዎ በፊት የቀለም አስተዳደር ባለው የምስል ማርትዕ መተግበሪያ ወደ sRGB PNG ይቀይሩት።"

ui_a_separate_recovery_copy_has_been_kep.source: %1$s A separate recovery copy has been kept. Use File > Export recovery copy to save its ZIP. Extract canvas.png from it and load that image to use the normal resize options if needed.
ui_a_separate_recovery_copy_has_been_kep.expected: "%1$s የተለየ የመልሶ ማግኛ ቅጂ ተጠብቋል። ZIP ፋይሉን ለማስቀመጥ ፋይል > የመልሶ ማግኛ ቅጂ ወደ ውጭ ላክ ይጠቀሙ። ከውስጡ canvas.png አውጥተው ምስሉን ይጫኑ፤ አስፈላጊ ከሆነ መደበኛውን የመጠን መቀየሪያ አማራጮች መጠቀም ይችላሉ።"

ui_an_assembly_source_image_is_missing.source: An assembly source image is missing.

ui_assembly_source_memory_floor.source: This assembly is estimated to exceed the current working-memory budget, even at the smallest output size. Reducing the assembly dimensions alone is not enough under the current limits. Close other documents or prepare a smaller source image before trying again. Your assembly is unchanged.
ui_assembly_source_memory_floor.expected: "ይህ የምስል ስብስብ በትንሹ የውጤት መጠን እንኳን አሁን ለሥራ ከተመደበው ማህደረ ትውስታ እንደሚበልጥ ይገመታል። ባሉት ገደቦች ውስጥ የስብስቡን ልኬቶች መቀነስ ብቻ በቂ አይደለም። እንደገና ከመሞከርዎ በፊት ሌሎች ሰነዶችን ይዝጉ ወይም አነስ ያለ ምንጭ ምስል ያዘጋጁ። ስብስቡ አልተለወጠም።"

ui_autosave_is_paused_to_protect_that_dr.source: %1$s Autosave is paused to protect that draft. Use “File → Export recovery copy…” to keep it, and “File → Save as…” (File format: PNG / JPEG) to save your current work.
ui_autosave_is_paused_to_protect_that_dr.expected: "%1$s ያንን ረቂቅ ለመጠበቅ ራስ-ሰር ማስቀመጥ ባለበት ቆሟል። እሱን ለማስቀመጥ “ፋይል → የመልሶ ማግኛ ቅጂ ወደ ውጭ ላክ…”፣ የአሁኑን ሥራዎ ለማስቀመጥ ደግሞ “ፋይል → አስቀምጥ እንደ…” (የፋይል ቅርጸት፦ PNG / JPEG) ይጠቀሙ።"

ui_autosave_pixels_could_not_be_read.source: Autosave pixels could not be read.

ui_cannot_create_the_undo_cache_free_som.source: Cannot create the undo cache. Free some device storage and try again.
ui_cannot_create_the_undo_cache_free_som.expected: "የመቀልበሻ ጊዜያዊ ማከማቻ መፍጠር አልተቻለም። በመሣሪያው ማከማቻ ውስጥ ቦታ ነጻ አድርገው እንደገና ይሞክሩ።"

ui_could_not_export_the_recovery_copy.source: Could not export the recovery copy
ui_could_not_export_the_recovery_copy.expected: "የመልሶ ማግኛ ቅጂውን ወደ ውጭ መላክ አልተቻለም"

ui_d_d_pixels_2f_mp_exceeds_the_current.source: %1$d × %2$d pixels (%3$.2f MP) exceeds the current safe editing budget of %4$.2f MP. AN Paint keeps the complete image in memory and reserves space for transforms and selections. Available memory determines this budget. The operation was stopped before allocating the oversized bitmap. No automatic resizing was applied.
ui_d_d_pixels_2f_mp_exceeds_the_current.expected: "%1$d × %2$d ፒክሰሎች (%3$.2f MP) አሁን በደህና ለማርትዕ ከተመደበው %4$.2f MP ይበልጣል። AN Paint ሙሉ ምስሉን በማህደረ ትውስታ ይይዛል፤ ለቅርጽ ለውጦችና ለተመረጡ ክፍሎችም ቦታ ይመድባል። ይህ መጠን በሚገኘው ማህደረ ትውስታ ይወሰናል። ከመጠን በላይ ለሆነው ቢትማፕ ማህደረ ትውስታ ከመመደቡ በፊት ክዋኔው ቆሟል። መጠኑ በራስ-ሰር አልተቀየረም።"

ui_export_did_not_save23.source: The export was created. Use Save or Save as to save the current image before continuing.
ui_export_did_not_save23.expected: "ወደ ውጭ የሚላከው ፋይል ተፈጥሯል። ከመቀጠልዎ በፊት የአሁኑን ምስል ለማስቀመጥ አስቀምጥ ወይም አስቀምጥ እንደ… ይጠቀሙ።"

ui_export_explanation23.source: Export an icon, Base64 text or ASCII art. Exporting keeps the current image and its Save destination unchanged.
ui_export_explanation23.expected: "አዶ፣ Base64 ጽሑፍ ወይም የASCII ስዕል ወደ ውጭ ይላኩ። ወደ ውጭ መላክ የአሁኑን ምስልና የማስቀመጫ መዳረሻውን አይቀይርም።"

ui_higher_quality_usually_makes_a_larger.source: Higher quality usually makes a larger file. Lossless keeps every colour value.
ui_higher_quality_usually_makes_a_larger.expected: "ከፍተኛ ጥራት ብዙውን ጊዜ የፋይሉን መጠን ያሳድጋል። ያለ መረጃ ኪሳራ ማስቀመጥ እያንዳንዱን የቀለም እሴት ይጠብቃል።"

ui_history_unavailable34.source: The canvas was restored, but its undo history could not be read. The original draft has been kept as a recovery copy.
ui_history_unavailable34.expected: "የስዕል ሰሌዳው ተመልሷል፤ ሆኖም የመቀልበሻ ታሪኩን ማንበብ አልተቻለም። ዋናው ረቂቅ እንደ መልሶ ማግኛ ቅጂ ተጠብቋል።"

ui_keeps_pixels_at_the_top_left_smaller_.source: Keeps pixels at the top left. Smaller canvas dimensions discard pixels beyond the right/bottom edge; Undo restores them.
ui_keeps_pixels_at_the_top_left_smaller_.expected: "ፒክሰሎችን ከላይ በግራ በኩል ያቆያል። የስዕል ሰሌዳው ልኬቶች ሲያንሱ ከቀኝ/ከታች ጠርዝ በላይ ያሉት ፒክሰሎች ይወገዳሉ፤ ቀልብስ ይመልሳቸዋል።"

ui_not_enough_memory_for_this_operation_.source: Not enough memory for this operation. The assembly source files are retained.
ui_not_enough_memory_for_this_operation_.expected: "ለዚህ ክዋኔ በቂ ማህደረ ትውስታ የለም። የምስል ስብስቡ ምንጭ ፋይሎች ተጠብቀዋል።"

ui_not_enough_memory_to_save_in_this_for.source: Not enough memory to save in this format. Try PNG
ui_not_enough_memory_to_save_in_this_for.expected: "በዚህ ቅርጸት ለማስቀመጥ በቂ ማህደረ ትውስታ የለም። PNG ይሞክሩ"

ui_recovery_copy_exported_extract_canvas.source: Recovery copy exported. Extract canvas.png from the ZIP and open it with File > Load image. The ZIP also contains draft settings and any floating selection.
ui_recovery_copy_exported_extract_canvas.expected: "የመልሶ ማግኛ ቅጂው ወደ ውጭ ተልኳል። canvas.png ከZIP ፋይሉ አውጥተው በፋይል > ምስል ክፈት… ይክፈቱት። ZIP ፋይሉ የረቂቁን ቅንብሮችና ማንኛውንም ገና ያልተዋሃደ የተመረጠ ክፍልም ይዟል።"

ui_the_decoder_and_editing_buffers_need_.expected: "ዲኮደሩና የማርትዕ ጊዜያዊ ማከማቻዎች ወደ %1$s ያህል ያስፈልጋቸዋል፤ አሁን በደህና ለማርትዕ የተመደበው መጠን %2$s ነው። አነስ ያለ ቅጂ ይምረጡ።"

ui_the_full_image_and_working_buffers_ex.source: The full image and working buffers exceed the current safe budget, or Android could not allocate them. Resize a copy to edit it. Your original file will stay unchanged.
ui_the_full_image_and_working_buffers_ex.expected: "ሙሉ ምስሉና ጊዜያዊ የሥራ ማከማቻዎች አሁን ካለው አስተማማኝ ገደብ ይበልጣሉ፣ ወይም Android ማህደረ ትውስታ ሊመድብላቸው አልቻለም። ለማርትዕ የቅጂውን መጠን ይቀይሩ። ዋናው ፋይልዎ ሳይለወጥ ይቆያል።"

ui_the_picker_returned_no_file_please_ch.source: The picker returned no file. Please choose the file again.
ui_the_picker_returned_no_file_please_ch.expected: "መምረጫው ፋይል አልመለሰም። እባክዎ ፋይሉን እንደገና ይምረጡ።"

ui_the_selected_provider_did_not_return_.source: The selected provider did not return any image data.

ui_this_file_is_not_a_supported_image_us.source: This file is not a supported image. Use PNG, JPEG, JPEG XL, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP, GIF, DIB, TIFF, ICO, PDF or Base64 image text.
ui_this_file_is_not_a_supported_image_us.expected: "ይህ ፋይል የሚደገፍ ምስል አይደለም። PNG፣ JPEG፣ JPEG XL፣ WebP፣ HEIC፣ AVIF፣ BMP፣ GIF፣ DIB፣ TIFF፣ ICO፣ PDF ወይም Base64 የምስል ጽሑፍ ይጠቀሙ።"

ui_too_large_for_the_current_budget_redu.source: Too large for the current budget. Reduce the dimensions or cancel and free memory.
ui_too_large_for_the_current_budget_redu.expected: "አሁን ከተመደበው መጠን በላይ ነው። ልኬቶቹን ይቀንሱ ወይም “ይቅር” ይምረጡና ማህደረ ትውስታ ነጻ ያድርጉ።"

ui_tool_categories.source: Tool categories. Scroll to see more tools

ui_trim_amounts_must_be_zero_or_greater.source: Trim amounts must be zero or greater.
ui_trim_amounts_must_be_zero_or_greater.expected: "የሚቆረጡ መጠኖች ዜሮ ወይም ከዜሮ በላይ መሆን አለባቸው።"

ui_trim_amounts_must_fit_inside_each_ima.source: Trim amounts must fit inside each image; use whole pixels or percentages.
ui_trim_amounts_must_fit_inside_each_ima.expected: "የሚቆረጡ መጠኖች ከእያንዳንዱ ምስል ወሰን ማለፍ የለባቸውም፤ ሙሉ ፒክሰሎችን ወይም መቶኛን ይጠቀሙ።"

ui_try_a_different_file_or_location.source: Please try a different file or location.
